tldr: Jupiter through the 7th house expands partners, close friends, clients, conflict, and attraction.
body:
When Jupiter moves through your 7th house, it makes more room around partners, close friends, clients, conflict, attraction, and what other people bring out in you. You may notice more through direct encounters with other people: what feels mutual, what feels unfair, and what someone else is reflecting back.

Hope, appetite, confidence, opportunity, and risk can all get bigger. It can help you say yes to something that gives your life more range.

The useful side is that this timing can make the next honest move easier to see. This is useful for seeing relationship patterns while they are active, not just after the fact.

The caution: Watch for taking on more than the situation, your schedule, or your judgment can hold. The risk is making the other person the whole problem or the whole solution.

Jupiter moves through this house for about a year. Let the opening be real, but keep your promises sized to the life you can actually live.
